segments.text: Sometimes the greatest failures are remembered as well as the greatest victories.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And such was the truth for Folsom's performance of the brewing storm at the marine barracks in Monmurg City.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: His admonition of the Sea Princes, all of them, Lord Jamis,
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Prince Jeon, Prince Fairwind, Prince Flotsam, Prince Jetsam, and Prince Toli would be etched in the mind of all of those Marines who, at the time, would grumble and seem angry at such thoughts, particularly because of their great patriotic feelings towards the sea principalities.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: However, as the days and weeks rolled on,
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: Treachery at Helm Island and the sightings of the sea ghost and the actions of the Toli reinforced Folsom's prediction.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: And the Marines began to realize that Folsom had insight into the future and what was coming their way.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: And they grudgingly accepted the wisdom of what he had said to them.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: And it was not just the Duke of Gradsall's doing.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: The jealousy and infighting of the sea princes added to the confusion and to the country's troubles.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: Soon they realized that Folsom was correct.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: There was a problem outside the principalities, but there were many problems within as well.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: And the troubles of the nation were not just from its enemies, but from its supposed friends as well.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: The Marines talked to one another about the song and its meaning and actually in time they began to wish that they could speak with Folsom and see what else he knew.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: Thus began Folsom's career in infamy as a bard of lore.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
